notes: The copula of 'wherein ye are' joins the fused wherein unit, since the preposition that is the predicate has no separate unit of its own (rule 49, with rule 30's allowance for a construction-supplied copula inside a fused expression).
The three-morpheme wherein unit was checked for atomicity and retained under rule 22.
no is the negative lo' recast onto the nominal of the light-verb rendering, which heads on expiation (rules 15, 44).
